uncovered_items: Canonical seven business lines are evidence-matrix/readback constructs; only worker-required lanes map onto C1-C8 cells, and projects_config_workflow/dashboard_admin_governance/runtime_ops have no dedicated successor cell.

LLM report export/token-state/audit/trend and request-identity/task-readback-metadata/single-source-guard service surfaces are visible donor business lines with no direct successor cell in the C1-C9 locator; B must adjudicate.

main/backend/app/api/business_lines.py and the entire llm_report_export/audit/token_state/trends + task_readback_metadata + request_identity + single_source_guard family are untracked working-tree files at donor HEAD (git_tracked_at_head=false); a clean checkout of HEAD would not contain them.

The evidence-matrix source_report path development/latest-dev-docs/automation-runs/business-line-user-flow-audit/2026-05-23/README.md was not found in the current donor tree; only business-line-worker-readback-project-matrix/2026-07-23 artifacts exist locally.
Credential values and live provider secrets were intentionally not read; codex_oauth.py/llm service configs are listed structurally only.

Migrations/versions and models cover business persistence, but the successor surface itself (main/backend/app/successor_runtime, capability specs, i1 assembly) lives in the manual worktree and was not inventoried as donor code.
